text: VfB Stuttgart's announcement names Maximilian Seifert as managing director and shareholder (Gesellschafter) of GREENOX GmbH, and Christoph Brechtel as a GREENOX GmbH shareholder. The company's legal notice gives its register entry as Amtsgericht Stuttgart, HRB 788621, represented by Maximilian Seifert and Simeon Forster.
short: GREENOX GmbH's named shareholders include managing director Maximilian Seifert and Christoph Brechtel.
